offer.title: Take a tour of MindRoom
offer.text: See how threads, titles and states work.

conversation.title: A thread is one conversation
conversation.text: Most rooms with agents open in Compact view. Each card is one thread: a single topic with all its replies together. A room holds as many as you need.

start.title: Type to start a new thread
start.text: Write in the box at the bottom of the room and send. That starts a new thread, and it opens right away.

reply.title: Inside a thread, you reply
reply.text: What you write in an open thread is a reply there, not a new thread. Back returns to the list, where any card opens its thread again.

title.title: AI writes the titles
title.text: A new card shows your first message. After an agent replies, MindRoom’s AI gives the thread a short title. Edit summary in Thread options changes it.

order.title: The latest activity comes first
order.text: A thread moves to the top when it gets a new message, so what is active comes first. Pinned threads stay above the rest.

states.title: A card shows where its thread stands
states.unread: New replies, with a colored edge and time.
states.snoozed: Hidden until its time, then back by itself.

resolve.title: Resolve what is done
resolve.text: Press Resolve, the check on a card, or swipe the card on a touch screen. The thread leaves the list, and you can reopen it at any time.

snooze.title: Snooze what can wait
snooze.text: In Thread options (⋯), pick Snooze. The thread hides until the time you choose, then returns with a note that the snooze ended.

pinAndTag.title: Pin and tag
pinAndTag.text: Pin keeps a thread at the top of the list. Edit tags in Thread options labels a thread, and you can filter by tag.

filters.title: Filters hide resolved threads
filters.text: Thread filters, in the room’s header or its menu, shows and hides this bar. Unresolved hides resolved threads: turn it off to see them again. Last Reply changes the order, and the filter icon at the bar’s end opens Advanced filters, which find the rest, snoozed threads too.

views.title: Two views of a room
views.text: Compact shows one card per thread. Threads shows each thread’s first message with its reply count under it. Compact view, in the room’s header or its menu, switches.

activity.title: Activity collects what needs you
activity.text: The bell opens Activity: mentions, replies in your threads and agent runs that finished. Approvals, questions and invites are answered right there.
